name: baseline
title: Baseline federation
description: No WW2; Polish-Lithuanian federation; moderate (southern-European) convergence

name: federal_autonomy
title: Ukrainian autonomy
description: Ukrainian territorial autonomy (Stanisławów, Tarnopol, Volhynia), Belarusian schooling, equal Lithuanian

name: integral_nationalism
title: Integral nationalism
description: Coercive Polonisation, emigrationist policy towards Jews, intensified eastern settlement

name: polonizing_union
title: Polonising unitary union
description: Unitary union: Polish dominant in the Lithuanian lands too

name: forced_lithuanization
title: Forced Lithuanisation
description: Federation, but the Lithuanian unit pursues forced Lithuanisation (as in the real interwar)

name: wilno_lithuanian
title: Wilno as Lithuanian capital
description: Federation with Vilnius as the Lithuanian capital (Lithuanian dominant in Wilno region)

name: lt_polish_claim
title: Polish 1923 claim for Lithuania (202 k)
description: Baseline with the 1923 Polish estimate of Poles in Lithuania

name: census_official
title: 1931 census as printed
description: Baseline started from the 1931 Polish and 1923 Lithuanian censuses as printed

name: census_vernacular
title: Upper-bound minority speech in 1931
description: Baseline with an upper-bound (Kubijovyč, 1897-anchored) 1931 starting point

name: stagnation
title: Stagnation
description: Low convergence; plans unexecuted; heavy emigration

name: ii_rp_only
title: Poland alone, no union
description: Second Polish Republic alone; no union with Lithuania

name: ukraine_autonomy_tricantonal
title: Ukrainian autonomy + tri-cantonal Lithuania
description: Ukrainian autonomy (Lwów, Tarnopol, Stanisławów voivodeships + Volhynia, 1922 statute) and a tri-cantonal Lithuanian-Polish-Belarusian Grand Duchy east of the Curzon line

name: autonomy_grand_duchy_coofficial
title: Ukrainian autonomy + trilingual Grand Duchy
description: Ukrainian autonomy and an autonomous Grand Duchy of Lithuania with Lithuanian, Polish and Belarusian co-official

name: poland_west_pl_be
title: Poland without the south-east and Wilno; Polish + Belarusian
description: Poland without Volhynia, Stanisławów, Tarnopol and the Lithuanian-claimed Wilno lands; Polish and Belarusian co-official

name: no_official_language
title: No official language
description: Poland with no official language (all languages equal); Lithuania as in the baseline
